inputs.commit_message: Synchronize canonical workspace after confirming ChatGPT changes are on main
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/hesham/gova
[ "$(git branch --show-current)" = main ] || { echo 'canonical not on main'; exit 42; }
tracked=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)
[ -z "$tracked" ] || { echo 'tracked changes exist; refusing to overwrite'; printf '%s\n' "$tracked"; exit 42; }
git fetch --prune origin main
git pull --ff-only origin main
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" ] || exit 43
[ -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ] || exit 44
echo "canonical-main=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
